decisions.reason: The QC drop helper is not applied to run computation. A persisted drop annotation is not proof that Gold excluded the source row.

decisions.reason: These four named valid requests retain the Python authorization outcome under the owner's exception. A general writer-everywhere rule does not authorize silently changing them.

decisions.reason: Native access is unproved. finding_audit, operational write sequence, work identity and source-observation additions require the Python operator migration/grant procedure; local SQLite bootstrap is not native provisioning proof.
decisions.disposition: Apply reviewed forward-only Python migrations/grants in a change window; verify native read/write/type cases separately. No EF migrations.

decisions.reason: Saving override intent and accepting recalculation work are separate transactions. A queue failure may leave saved intent; resaving an unchanged override does not repair it.
decisions.disposition: Decide atomicity/reconciliation protocol; preserve uncertain accepted intent, never retry blindly.

decisions.reason: The 600-second compute lease has no periodic renewal while synchronous compute runs. Publication checks/renewal protect stale commits, not uninterrupted long native work.
decisions.disposition: Prove long native work and recovery under agreed lease policy before enabling writes.

decisions.reason: Stable count/max misses count/max-preserving edits, SQL synchronization lag and historical snapshot identity. Missing/all-null maxima cannot prove stability.
decisions.disposition: Accept the explicit observation limit or provide a stronger version source; treat changed/unprovable pairs as inconclusive.

decisions.reason: Instrumentation registration and local traces do not prove the real exporter receives events. Parallel deployment assets and their results are not merged inputs.
decisions.disposition: Verify safe real exporter receipt and redaction in an approved environment before cutover.

decisions.reason: Header mapping is not authentication. Real signed-token validation alone does not establish employer binding or authentic platform headers at a direct origin.
decisions.disposition: Strip/replace untrusted headers at authenticated ingress, isolate origins, validate audiences and bind the acting person to the employer. Exclude private reads until proved.

decisions.scope: different confirmations sharing an idempotency key
decisions.reason: Gateway idempotency-key exclusion is host-local. Same-confirmation atomic consume does not prove fleet-wide exclusion across distinct confirmations or replicas.
decisions.disposition: Choose durable cross-replica reservation/retention or a reviewed single-authority limit.

decisions.reason: Conversation checkpoints and budgets survive fresh graph creation only inside one process. Restart, another replica or expiry can lose confirmations and recovery identity.
decisions.disposition: Agree retention, affinity, restart and replica durability before directing conversations or confirmations.

decisions.scope: production gateway bridge after unknown acknowledgement
decisions.reason: The orchestrator retains a recovery-only slot locally, but the production bridge has no resultLookup and no result-recovery endpoint. An uncertain mutation cannot be repaired by replaying it in shadow.
decisions.disposition: Stop automatic retries, retain original identity, reconcile durable evidence manually; design recovery before production writes.

decisions.scope: API, Worker, Gold and manifest ownership
decisions.reason: Split accepted Gold/manifest destinations or competing Python/.NET Workers can make a successful write invisible or execute work twice. A route-only traffic change is insufficient.
decisions.owner: API, queue, persistence and change owners
decisions.disposition: Move the complete write lifecycle under one authority and one accepted destination, with controlled drain and lease reconciliation.

decisions.scope: package creation, metadata, download, tickets and export
decisions.reason: Package generations and audit must stay coherent. Links mint tickets, downloads consume them and record artifact access, even when the HTTP method is GET. Never mirror them live.
decisions.disposition: Keep each generation/lifecycle on its authority through expiry; preserve immutable bytes, hashes and audit on rollback.
